QuestInfo.name: Deer, my dear
QuestInfo.0:
Much of the forest fell in that desperate fight. 
Even the Great Tree, which stood tall in the center of the spring for thousands of years, met its end.
QuestInfo.2:
Gaia scattered the life force inside her, the power that sustained her for all these eons. 
Her body started to vanish, but at the same time, the forest grew strong again. 

You tried to stop Gaia, to look for another way, but she only smiled and shook her head.

With love and kindness in her heart, she departed.
